name: PADI AWARE Foundation Community Grant Program
summary: Small grants for grassroots ocean projects by PADI Dive Centers and small non-profits, covering marine protected areas, vulnerable marine species, coral reef recovery, marine debris and the dive industry's carbon footprint.
reporting: Grantees must provide a Project Report on the outcomes of the agreed upon project at the end of the funding cycle, due within one month of the project's end.

eligibility.rule: Annual budget is less than USD 1 million if the applicant is a nonprofit

documents: Recent financial statement confirming annual budget is less than 1 million USD, if a nonprofit
